observations: The source head/eyes/hair, hands, plaid hem and full shoe extent remain recognizable and no source RGB, pose or canvas was redrawn.

The v2 coverage includes a visibly larger narrow original linen receiver at the palm/seat and an irregular original wood receiver around the shoes. This is fixed included material, not a movable independent shadow.
The formerly missing floor point (905,898) is now covered: v1 (0,0,0), v2 (253,252,253), original mother (65,35,13). The recomposed contact darkness is closer to the original.

The v2 mask introduces a thin partial-coverage hole along the inner knee/leg contact on actual source flesh. At (998,644), v1 is (254,253,254), v2 is (50,50,48), mother is (142,97,84), while the background is (75,40,18).
Fine light contours are visible around parts of the shoe soles in the v2 checker/recomposition comparison; this is recorded as a fidelity concern rather than declaring the entire shoe missing.
Complete scene resemblance and better receiver coverage do not override the newly observed internal coverage gap.

issues.finding: Actual flesh pixel (998,644) is low luminance (50,50,48) in v2 instead of solid foreground white; the joint sprite therefore partially reveals the receiver through the body interior. No source edit/geometry fill is applied.
V2 checker/recomposition shows thin light contour lines along portions of the soles unlike the original dark edge. Entire shoe extent is present, but full unbroken source coverage is not signed.
